name: README no-cloud description versus live AI routing
description: README describes a self-contained slice without cloud/third-party AI dependencies. Architecture depicts outbound providers but names OpenAI-compatible/Microsoft STT/configurable TTS without Discovery/account routing. Current factories support fake, direct OpenAI/Discovery and a two-provider router. The README statement fits fake mode rather than all supported configurations.
documentedClaim: Self-contained operation without cloud or third-party AI dependencies.
observedBehavior: Live providers and system/account fallback are implemented alongside default fake mode.
unknowns: Active environment and deployed provider selection intentionally not examined.

name: Claim fencing does not prove side-effect exclusivity
description: Completion/failure predicates match status/owner/attempt rather than leaseExpiresAt. Reviewed runner has no lease renewal or cancellation path; an expired handler could continue after another claim. External/domain writes therefore cannot be assumed exactly once. Configuration lengthens lease to at least three provider timeouts plus 10 seconds when evaluation/STT is live.
unknowns: Overlapping side effects after expiry were not reproduced.
Expired but not reclaimed job can still complete because expiry is absent from update predicate.

name: Timer serialization is not global concurrency configuration
description: pollActive serializes only private timer poll. AudioGenerationService calls public runOnce in a bounded loop outside that flag; runOnce has no enabled check or concurrency gate. Database locks protect claims, but a fixed global concurrency of one cannot be inferred.
unknowns: Actual concurrency depends on request/process overlap and was not measured.
workerEnabled controls timer startup rather than direct runOnce calls.

name: Manual job retry does not reset FAILED audio candidate
description: Terminal/exhausted audio failure marks artifact FAILED. retryJob resets Job fields only, while the handler requires its existing candidate to be GENERATING. A retryable job may therefore be scheduled without its failed artifact becoming eligible again. This consequence is inferred across code paths and not reproduced.
unknowns: Exhausted-audio manual retry was not executed; a fresh generation request can create a new candidate.

name: Publication request hash omits import identity
description: Publication receipt lookup uses actor/operation/key; request hash includes revision/hash/key/audio selection but omits importId. Receipt replay precedes import lookup. Cross-import requests with otherwise identical hashed fields could replay another import response. Audio generation includes contentImportId in its hash.
unknowns: Cross-import replay scenario not exercised; no incident claimed.

name: Transport and deployment guarantees remain unknown
description: Source cookie secure=false is unconditional. API and development Compose database bind loopback; Next forwards to configured API origin. These sources do not establish deployed TLS, proxy trust, hostname, process count or filesystem permissions.
verifiedFacts: Cookie secure flag is false in source.
API and development database bind loopback.

name: Job correlation and rate-limit cleanup scheduling are unverified
description: Architecture describes request/job correlation IDs. Rate-limit cleanup is an injectable one-day-default method; reviewed source search found no production caller or scheduler.
verifiedFacts: Request correlation and safe structured logger implementations exist.
Cleanup method exists, but not a scheduler in its class.
unknowns: External scheduling, operational retention and complete request-to-job correlation unverified.
